subject: Follow-up: Ops playbook & evaluation slate for POC
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystdata.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Ops playbook & evaluation slate for POC

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Summary of pain points you shared
- High false-positive rate on customer support routing (current F1 ~0.58) causing manual triage.
- Inconsistent latency spikes during peak hours (page load + model latency > 1.2s).
- Need to preserve PHI redaction and strict data retention for EU customers.

Goals for the POC (mutual):
1) Reduce routing false positives to F1 >= 0.75 on your labeled prompt set.
2) Demonstrate median generation latency < 300ms for 512-token sequence under standard load.
3) Validate on-device redaction heuristics + retention policy compliance for EU subset.

Proposed POC scope (30 days):
- Dataset: 5k labelled routing examples + 2k unlabeled logs for sampling.
- Metrics: F1/precision/recall for routing, p50/p95 latency, token-cost per 1k requests.
- Deliverables: prompt eval slate, weekly checkpoint calls, final playbook with tuning notes.

Action items we discussed (owners and rough timeline):
- Catalyst: share dataset extract (S3 link) + procurement contact by EOD Friday. (Oliver / Priya)
- Redwood: provide access stub, SOC2 evidence summary, and initial prompt eval slate by Monday. (Marissa)
- Both: schedule kickoff for week of July 26th pending access. (Mateo)

Attachments: redwood-poc-charter-v1.pdf — working draft of scope and success gates.

If that all looks right, can you confirm dataset delivery and your procurement contact? I’ll loop legal for a simple MSA amendment if needed.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Engagement Lead — Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@catalystdata.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@stackline.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -07:00

Thanks, Mateo — that matches our readout. Two quick clarifications:

1) Metrics: we want to add an additional business KPI — % reduction in manual triage hours per 10k tickets (baseline ~ 48 hours/week). If you can include that in the playbook that's great.
2) Compliance: Priya (cc'd) owns security and procurement. She'll send the S3 location and will raise a SOC2 checklist request.

Priya — can you confirm the S3 path and an expected handoff date? We can target July 23rd for the dataset if that works.

Oliver
VP Product — Catalyst Data

Subject: Ops playbook & prompt-eval slate (draft)

Hi all — attaching the initial prompt evaluation slate and an ops playbook sketch for the 30-day POC. Highlights:

- Week 0 (onboarding): access + baseline run (sanity checks, token counts).
- Week 1–2 (calibration): prompt tuning, KV cache strategies, quantization suggestion (int8) for cost tests.
- Week 3 (load & SLO tests): p50/p95 latency measurements, cost-per-1k token evals, and manual triage reduction assessment.
- Week 4 (handoff): final report, playbook, and recommendations for Dedicated capacity if you want predictable throughput.

Owners:
- Data handoff & labels: Catalyst (Oliver / Priya)
- Access & infra: Redwood infra ops (Marissa)
- Model tuning & evals: Redwood applied ML (Karthik)

Attachments: prompt-eval-slates.xlsx (contains the seeds, negative examples, evaluation rubric), and quick access instructions stub (redwood-access-instructions.txt).

Quick asks: Oliver — can we get the S3 path and an IAM user or role that can read data by Friday? Also, Priya — SOC2 questionnaire (we'll send a short evidence pack) — is there a preferred format (PDF vs form)?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Engagement Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Appreciate the quick turn. Final confirmation from our side:
